$comment: Every credential the leaves cite, every exam they must no longer cite, and the numbered frameworks they cite by ID.
Maintained by hand from vendor sources: nothing in this repository can check a vendor, so each entry records where its facts came from and how well.

evidence: 'read' = the source page was fetched and read; 'search-extract' = the vendor's pages were blocked to the checker and the facts come from search-engine extracts of them; 'unverified' = no vendor text could be read.

credentials[].label is the exact bold text a leaf's alignment line must use. domains, where recorded, are copied from the vendor's study guide; a line citing such a credential must open with one of them. An empty domains list means none could be read, and the line's coverage is free text.
retired[].names are matched loosely (any case for codes, any dash or whitespace, across line breaks); keep them specific enough not to collide with a current credential.

validate-content fails on a retired exam anywhere in a leaf, an unregistered or non-canonical label, a missing domain, or an OWASP ID without its edition. Run 'npm run regen' after editing: ASSUMPTIONS.md summarises this file.
